paper.title: Volumetric Spanners: an Efficient Exploration Basis for Learning

settings.name_in_paper: Bandit Linear Optimization (BLO) over general convex sets
unmapped: Learner needs (a bound on) the size of a 1/T-net of K, log|K|_{1/T}, to tune eta and gamma
settings.definition_quote: The set $\K$ is equipped with a membership oracle. ... The losses are bounded in absolute values by 1. That is, the loss functions are always chosen (by an oblivious adversary)  from a convex set $\cal Z$ such that $\K$ is contained in its polar, i.e. $\forall L \in {\cal Z}, x \in \K$, $|L^\top x| \leq 1$.

symbols.s: max_t |S_t|, size of the exploration spanner set
symbols.N_net: |K|_{1/T}, size of a 1/T-net of K w.r.t. the norm defined by the loss set

conditions: losses satisfy |L^T x| <= 1 for all x in K (loss set in polar of K)

source.label: thm:geo hedge
source.quote: Under the assumptions stated above, and let $s=\max_t |S_t|$, $ \eta = \sqrt{\frac{\log |\K|_{1/T}}{dT}}$ and let $\gamma = s\sqrt{\frac{\log(|\K|_{1/T})}{dT}} $. Algorithm \ref{alg:BLO} given parameters $\gamma,\eta$ suffers a regret bounded by $$ O\left(  (s+d)\sqrt{\frac{T \log |\K|_{1/T} }{d}} \right)$$

results.notes: Regret is E[sum L_t^T x_t] - sum L_t^T x* against oblivious adversary. Efficiency per Corollary 7.2 (polynomial per-iteration time with approximate sampling).

conditions: losses satisfy |L^T x| <= 1 for all x in K
tuning: eta, gamma as in Theorem 7.1 with s = d

source.quote: There exist an efficient algorithm for BLO for any convex set $\K$ with regret of $$ O\left(  \sqrt{dT \log |\K|_{1/T}  } \right) = O\left(  d\sqrt{T \log(T)  } \right) $$

results.notes: Follows from Theorem 7.1 with s = d (the paper's argument; the exp-volumetric spanner part is from sampling). Running time per iteration O~(d^5 + d^3 T^6) per Corollary 7.2.

conditions: losses satisfy |L^T x| <= 1 for all x in K
tuning: eta, gamma as in Theorem 7.1 with s = d
